patches.why: CR16ToolAbilityCS::GetUpgradeLevel (vtable slot +0x340, shared only by IOScanner/MageHand/CureGun/Cutter/FaradayProjector/ToolAbility CS): mov rax,[entry+0xab0] -> mov eax,2. This is what R16ToolAbilityUpgradeLevelExpression (0x140c970b0) hands to scripts.
CR16CutterToolCS update (vtable slot 119, 0x140a7e8b0): level used as index into the cutter CD per-level float table [CD+0x130][level*4] -> level 2.
CR16CutterToolCS update: second per-level table read [CD+0x130][level*4] -> level 2.
Cutter beam helper 0x140a934b0 (tail-called from the cutter update): per-level table [CD+0x1d8][level*4] -> level 2.
Cutter beam helper 0x140a934b0: second per-level read -> level 2.

CR16MageHandCS::SetUpgradeLevel override (vtable +0x348, 0x14074a7c0) caches table[level] from [CD+0x118] into entry+0xab8: mov eax,[r9+rsi*4] -> mov eax,[r9+8] = always the level-2 value. Takes effect the next time the game sets the magehand level.
CR16CutterToolCS::SetUpgradeLevel override (0x140a6bba0) caches table[level] from [CD+0xf8] into entry+0xab8 -> always the level-2 value. Takes effect the next time the game sets the cutter level.

evidence: Tool upgrade level = qword at tool component entry+0xab0 (stride 0xb78, entries at [cs+0x100], index map [cs+0xd0]). Vtables from RTTI: CR16ToolAbilityCS 0x141a657d8 and subclasses MageHand 0x141a4cdd8, Cutter 0x141a84498, CureGun 0x141a833e8, FaradayProjector 0x141a9ff18 (+IOScanner) share slot +0x340 = getter 0x140772ca0 and slot +0x348 = setter 0x140924be0 (MageHand/Cutter override +0x348 to also cache a per-level table value at entry+0xab8). Whole-.text scan of qword reads of +0xab0: the gameplay readers are the cutter update + helper and the faraday update + helper patched here; they index per-level tables in the tool's CD (cutter [CD+0x130],[CD+0x1d8]; faraday [CD+0x108]). Level 2 = max: r16_player_upgrade has exactly upg_<tool>_1 and _2 for cutter, faraday and magehand. Nothing writes +0xab0 except the setter, so no save data changes (read-side). NOT covered: radiation shield (upg_radiation_shield_*; the 'upgradedheaddamage'/'upgradeddamagerate' fields belong to player-nav damage data, selection not located) and upg_unsticky_creep. NOT verified in game: effect strength, that every table has 3 entries, and the magehand/cutter cached value only refreshes when the game next calls SetUpgradeLevel.
risk: Read-side: turning it off restores the true level at once, except the magehand/cutter cached value, which reverts at the next SetUpgradeLevel. Scripts asking for a tool's upgrade level (R16ToolAbilityUpgradeLevelExpression) see 2 for every tool while on, so upgrade-station offers or dialogue may be skipped or act as if done; the saved upgrade state is untouched. Four more +0xab0 readers (0x140adc6f0, 0x140aedf20, 0x140aee440, 0x140b23f30; stride-0x140 table pattern) are left alone because 0x140aedf20 is COMDAT-shared with CR16ImpulseToHandTouchTypeCS, so their owners are unconfirmed. If a table has fewer than 3 entries, index 2 reads past it (garbage values from the resource arena). Applied at game launch only: some patches are longer than one atomic 8-byte write, so changing them while the game runs could let a thread execute a half-written instruction. FARADAY REMOVED (2026-11-10): forcing the faraday field-count loop bound to level 2 crashed the game when the projector was used on biomass (two BugSplat dumps, AV reading [-1+0x2180] in the component-ref resolver 0x14013c260, called from CR16FaradayProjectorFieldExpression 0x140cf55b0 -> field lookup 0x140acc350). The field array (+0xba0, stride 0xd8) is allocated for the max level, but other faraday code (0x140adc6f0, 0x140aedf20, 0x140aee440, 0x140b23f30) still loops with the real level from +0xab0, so a slot activated by the level-2 loop never got its target ref (+0x60 left at the -1 template). The faraday projector now runs at its real level; cutter and magehand are unchanged. The shared getter 0x140772ca0 still reports 2 for the faraday to scripts.
